the following holds true for the number of linear region in a deep neural network with $L$ layers: 1) The number of linear regions in a rectified network with $L-1$ layers is at most $2L-1$; 2) The number of such regions is at most $3L-2$ for a network with maxout units; 3) The number of regions can grow exponentially with the number of layers for networks with ReLU units.
